args: Implement docs/plans/trust-and-accuracy-plan.md using existing data only and adding no new features: open one draft PR with the preview URL at the top; Part 1 store each instrument's page text with its PDF checksum, make the citation and fidelity checks in CI read only that stored text, remove the fallback that rebuilds page text from published clauses, fail on missing page text, and prove it with planted-fault tests; Part 2 replace the map's 0.0032 m claim with the measured accuracy generated from the verification report, rebuild the map page in the Bylaw One design, and link it from the footer and the Land use page; Part 3 use plain register names in every source cell and label with a CI check, and fix the home page's 2017 and 2007 attributions so their quotes pass the citation check; Part 4 show only structurally confirmed relation kinds publicly, keep the labelling sheet ready, and record the 0.8 precision rule; Part 5 make the resolver return "needs depth/width/height" instead of assuming dimensions and distinguish "no limit in the law" from "not covered by our data", tested on the four review plots, without showing it on the site; commit and push after each part, keep docs/progress.md current and the PR's "For owner review", "Decisions made" and "Known gaps" sections up to date; never invent or rewrite legal text.
